limitations: Release upload, extraction and activation here cover chart v2 f22f3d0 on staging only.
Byte-identical served chart files and a successful Binance REST read show the release content and upstream reach, not production-scale market-data capacity (gate MD-1).
Unchanged activity counts across activation do not verify webhook delivery during the restart window.
The EXIT verification is a read-only API reading for one bot on staging Paper; the net result is an estimate, not an analytics figure.
Future publication and activation require fresh facts and separate reviewed authority.
